title: Keylong, Lahaul: Kardang and Shashur Monasteries, Jispa and the Road to Leh
seo_title: Keylong, Lahaul: Monasteries, Jispa, Weather & How to Reach
seo_desc: Keylong, Lahaul's main town at about 3,080 m on the Bhaga river: Kardang and Shashur monasteries, Jispa, Trilokinath, winter snow, and how to reach from Manali through the Atal Tunnel (about 70 km).
